packet_summary: 74-year-old single woman, currently homeless (Z59.00), referred for major depressive disorder. The face sheet and MAR read like a skilled-nursing facility stay ('Resident', LOS 36), though the referral says hospital admit. Diagnoses: thoracolumbar disc degeneration (primary), MDD, unspecified dementia, unspecified psychosis, anxiety, insomnia, protein-calorie malnutrition, generalized weakness, unsteadiness on feet, ASHD. Medications: risperidone 1 mg BID, mirtazapine 7.5 mg qHS, escitalopram, PRN lorazepam, temazepam, ondansetron, acetaminophen, milk of magnesia. Penicillin allergy. Vitals stable and afebrile, SpO2 95–98% on room air. PT: walks 300 ft ×2 independently without a device, transfers independently, needs max encouragement, psych precautions. 2-step PPD with a 0 mm reading. Missing: H&P, AOx/mental-status exam, SI screen, MRSA and COVID swabs, OT eval, discharge med list, psychiatric stability statement, most progress notes. Both referral forms say no cognitive impairment, but the chart lists dementia.
